description: Request RecipeBee image generation for an existing private recipe. Generation may reserve existing RecipeBee image credits or consume a free-tier image allowance. On protocol 2026-07-28, the server requires an accepted confirmation form bound to this recipe and these image options; image_generation_confirmed is ignored. On older MCP clients, omit image_generation_confirmed until the user explicitly accepts, then set it to true on one retry. This tool never purchases credits or starts checkout; if the existing entitlement is unavailable, report the failure without directing the user to a purchase flow. Do not use for an image already generated or uploaded in this conversation. mode=add retains the current primary image. mode=replace changes which retained image is primary but does not delete the previous image; use it only after the user explicitly requests replacement.

image_generation_confirmed.description: For pre-2026 MCP clients only: set to true after explaining possible credit or free-allowance use and receiving the user’s explicit acceptance. Protocol 2026-07-28 ignores this value and collects consent in a signed confirmation form.

name: generate_recipe_image
title: Generate recipe image
